english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making a physical object longer by pulling, stretching, or extending it.
Use this when pulling something longer or when a duration becomes longer.
Use this mainly when making a physical object or measurable length longer.

examples.english: Help me elongate the rubber band so I can tie both ends.
examples.traditional: 你幫我拉長條橡筋，等我綁住兩邊。

examples.english: This elastic can stretch a lot.
examples.traditional: 呢條橡筋可以拉長好多。
examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 ho2 ji5 laai1 coeng4 hou2 do1

examples.english: The rope is too short, so we need to prolong it a little before we can use it.
examples.traditional: 條繩唔夠長，要拉長少少先夠用。
